proof_body:
by
  intro R _ _ f hf
  let k : ℕ →o Ideal R := ⟨fun n => RingHom.ker (f ^ n), by
    refine monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun n x hx => ?_
    simp only [RingHom.mem_ker] at hx ⊢
    rw [pow_succ', RingHom.mul_def, RingHom.comp_apply, hx, map_zero]⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := monotone_stabilizes_iff_noetherian.mpr (inferInstance : IsNoetherian R R) k
  refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero f).mpr fun x hx => ?_
  have hfn : Function.Surjective (f ^ n) := by
    rw [RingHom.coe_pow]
    exact hf.iterate n
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hfn x
  have hy : y ∈ k (n + 1) := by
    simp only [k]
    show (f ^ (n + 1)) y = 0
    rw [pow_succ', RingHom.mul_def, RingHom.comp_apply, hx]
  rw [← hn (n + 1) (Nat.le_succ n)] at hy
  exact hy
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (f : R →+* R), Function.Surjective f → Function.Injective f
